top_signals.title: Tech Earnings Loom Large for Hedge Funds Packed Into Dispersion Trade
top_signals.summary: Equity option traders will be looking for the market to break out of its inertia as tech company earnings collide with a Federal Reserve meeting and US midterm elections.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
